justifications.technical_correctness: Gravity, floor-gated jump, movement, deferred monitoring and single collection are all correct.
justifications.api_correctness: All the APIs used exist with correct signatures: move_and_slide, get_axis, set_deferred, signals.
justifications.version_compatibility: Uses Godot 4 idioms: @export, signal.emit(), Callable connect, velocity property.
justifications.architectural_quality: Clean separation, coin uses a group filter and emits a signal, decoupled and extensible.
justifications.requirement_fulfillment: Player physics and the one-time coin pickup signal are fully implemented as required.
justifications.source_quality: Cites no documentation or other sources for any claim.
justifications.provenance: Claims are explained but not traced to any documentation or evidence.
justifications.hallucinations: No invented APIs or behavior. The claim about blocked monitoring changes is accurate.
justifications.clarity: Explanation is concise, structured per script, and actionable.
